d: A surgeon (Wayne Rogers) drops dead while he's operating on another doctor (Jack Klugman).
A pilot of an airliner carrying Dr. Sloan and Amanda to a medical conference in Europe is murdered.
A wealthy woman and her lover concoct an elaborate scheme to do in her husband.
A comedian (Tim Conway) makes a bumbling attempt to do in his more successful former partner (Harvey Korman)---whose wife turns up dead.
A mad bomber whom Dr. Sloan helped put away has escaped and wants the good doctor blown away.

When Christine Rankin, the first Black female officer on the Sparta police force, is killed during the capture of a murder suspect, the city council makes plans to suspend Gillespie, but he voluntarily steps down and sets out to get justice.

As the arrests grow, Gillespie, Tibbs and the Sparta police force are desperate to halt the spread of crack cocaine among the young people of their town, and no one is more motivated than Officer Willson Sweet, whose cousin died from using the drug.
